observations.trace: Helmet recipe calls HelmetDesign::validate before generating parts. Crown and cheek fluting are separately checked through PlateFluting::validate, which admits flute counts2..64 and a positive bounded spread, width and fade. columns(40) always seeds distinct left and right pattern edges; the bounded flute sample spacing is far above the 1e-5 merge tolerance. The dome constructs48 rim entries independently of fluting and at least23 latitude rows, and its ring construction uses the same columns for every row. The examined dome, brim, nape, peak, guard, buffe-grid, barbute, sallet and visor callers construct matching nonempty ring lengths before CoordSurface::connect.
observations.remaining: Source and bounded arithmetic only; no columns, topology, helmet, shader or test ran. Arbitrary direct helper inputs and all other geometry/native contracts remain open. Original scoped Lens12 producer/delegate evidence cannot be expanded to the full body; historical Lens2/Lens3 and Adler independently read full scope.

observations.trace: The selected extremity entry validates LimbArmorDesign before dispatching to boot/sabaton. Boot shaft height is restricted to40..350mm, excluding zero for the shaft-height denominator on this path; sabaton lame_count is3..8. Helmet recipe validates before burgonet; BuffeDesign calls BuffeCourses::validate, whose plate_count is2..3, excluding the empty course vector and the course-array overrun for the selected pipeline.
observations.remaining: No device, denominator, frame, shape, renderer or test ran. Frame contents and all other divisors or callers are not thereby proven valid.

observations.contract: Breath placement versus a shortened buffe top course
observations.trace: BuffeDesign validates its breath pattern and its course settings separately. For a hypothetical otherwise-valid burgonet using BuffeCourses::default() (three plates, upper boundary700 permille, overlap5mm) and VisorBreaths::buffe() with height changed to820 permille, each local validator accepts its selected controls: the four 3mm slots in a54mm span meet the 3mm horizontal web, the two side patterns are separated, and the height lies in50..950. The top course chart height is 100*(1-0.700)+5 ≈35mm, allowing for f32 rounding. Openings are instead positioned using a100mm chart, so their centers lie at82mm, with vertical half-length6mm for the zero-inclination buffe preset. PiercedDomain checks every hole point is inside the approximately35mm outer chart with a3mm web and returns VisorOpeningSpacing before triangulation if not. The selected editor source offers both overlapping faceplates and a breath-height control spanning50..950.
observations.remaining: This is a concrete source-derived conditional combination, not a constructed design, UI interaction, geometry, triangulation or runtime observation. Other outer helmet conditions are assumed valid; exact intended control policy and all native consumers remain open. The later geometry boundary rejects the combination rather than silently publishing it.

observations.contract: Packed helmet tags and shader source
observations.trace: CoordSurface stores a VertexKind discriminant as a native float coordinate; the same shared_codes declaration emits the WGSL u32 constants. Fixed small enum tags and chart shader program text have native ABI/source roles rather than by themselves proving a generic semantic-string or primitive-ID defect. The selected extremity chart kernel explicitly assembles shader program text from its design and shape functions.
observations.remaining: Historical Lens2 q2404 and Lens12 q2691 are qualified negative dispositions for selected scopes, not independent current-lens clearance or a claim that every packing bound is correct. Full shader and native compilation remain untested.
